top_creatures.label: Storm ring
top_creatures.why: A roaming hazard that wanders, cannot attack, and can move onto the player so the player is carried off their line. It reads as weather, a different threat shape from a monster.
top_creatures.keep: A hazard that moves the player; wandering with no attack.
top_creatures.change: A telegraphed spinning ring with a ground shadow and a slow tick sound; storm, not water.

top_creatures.label: Split jelly
top_creatures.why: Survives a hit, then a 1-in-2 roll splits it; the copy takes half the HP. The damage the player dealt creates the threat.
top_creatures.keep: Split on a surviving hit, driven by the damage the player dealt.
top_creatures.change: Fix the HP rounding (child floor(hp/2), parent takes the rest), cap splits per encounter, and give each split a squish sound. Splits also come from field damage in the engine, so cap those too.

top_creatures.label: Bloom spawner
top_creatures.why: Dies into another monster. A death that adds a threat keeps the fight going without a new encounter.
top_creatures.keep: A death that spawns a creature of a set type.
top_creatures.change: One-second telegraph before the swarm, a smaller swarm, and spawns count against the attacker cap. The spawn is behind an enhancement flag in the engine.

top_creatures.label: Chest mimic
top_creatures.why: Looks like a chest, does not move, and reveals within 5 tiles. A camouflaged threat that rewards careful walking.
top_creatures.change: Reveal at 2 tiles with a lid tremor as the tell; no reveal through walls.

top_creatures.label: Warding sage
top_creatures.why: When it acts it puts an anti-magic aura on the party for two turns. A visible rule that blocks the player's spells.
top_creatures.keep: A single timed anti-magic aura that the party can read.
top_creatures.change: A visible halo on the caster, a counter-spell sound, and a real-time duration instead of turns.

top_creatures.label: Escort ladder
top_creatures.why: Rarer elites enter a common group by a dice roll (1-in-8 leader, 1-in-32 grand-leader per slot), so a low-tier row can bring an elite chain.
top_creatures.keep: The odds and the rule that the base row is always present.
top_creatures.change: An elite announces itself with a banner or horn; zone data decides which chain can appear in which zone.

top_creatures.label: Pack swarm
top_creatures.why: Large groups of small creatures that are weak alone. Group size is a per-row number, so swarm size is data.
top_creatures.keep: Group size as a per-row field.
top_creatures.change: Fewer visible bodies at 375 wide, the melee cap of 3 respected, and the rest waiting in a ring.

top_creatures.label: Lava line thrower
top_creatures.why: A ranged attack that uses a terrain effect and a leave-tile flag, and it resists fire. The ground changes because of the fight.
top_creatures.keep: A ranged attack that changes the ground.
top_creatures.change: A glow line that fades in a second, with no lasting terrain change. What the leave-tile flag does in the engine was not read.

looks.label: Water scroll
looks.technique: tile scroll advancing 4 steps a second; water uses a pool tile to scroll

looks.label: Idle frame at half rate
looks.technique: frame advances on about half of draws via a random percent gate; when the gate fails the sprite holds its last frame

looks.label: Slow idle
looks.technique: slow frame at a random 5 percent gate (guards)

looks.label: Flame band
looks.technique: a warm colour band is repainted with random jitter each frame; no colour copied

looks.label: Phantom flicker
looks.technique: frame plus scroll on a flicker sprite

looks.label: Flag animations
looks.technique: invert-based flag animations with context frames (city, castle, ship, pirate)

looks.label: Effect tiles per ranged row
looks.technique: magic flash, hit flash, poison field, rocks, energy, sleep, lava as the hit and miss tile for ranged rows (magic flash 6 rows, hit flash 3, poison 3, rocks 2, others 1 each; single-line rows only)

looks.label: Camouflage reveal
looks.technique: hidden creature shows when the nearest opponent is within 5 tiles

looks.label: Death line
looks.technique: a short message on the defeat line; XP reported only for a kill by the player

looks.label: Sound cue set
looks.technique: named cues for cast start, flash, fizzle, poison, evade, heal, level up, gate, wind and whirlpool (sound list, not played)

originals.name: Storm Ring
originals.idea: A wandering hazard that cannot attack and carries the player when it moves onto them.
originals.keep: A hazard that moves the player; no attack.
originals.change: Telegraphed spinning ring with a shadow and tick sound; zone data sets its path. Parity rows 4 and 23.

originals.name: Split Slime
originals.idea: A creature that splits after it survives a hit, so the player's damage creates the threat.
originals.change: HP split floor(hp/2) and parent takes the rest; splits capped per encounter; splits count toward the attacker cap. Parity rows 1 and 18.

originals.name: Bloom Spawner
originals.idea: A creature that dies into a swarm.
originals.keep: A death that adds a threat.
originals.change: One-second telegraph, a smaller swarm, and the swarm uses the attacker cap. Parity row 17.

originals.name: Chest Mimic
originals.idea: A hidden threat that looks like a loot chest and reveals in range.
originals.change: Reveal at 2 tiles with a lid tremor, no reveal through walls. Parity row 11.

originals.name: Warding Sage
originals.idea: A caster whose action puts a timed anti-magic aura on the party.
originals.keep: One visible aura slot with a duration.
originals.change: Halo, counter-spell cue, real-time seconds. Parity row 13.

originals.name: Escort Ladder
originals.idea: Elites join common groups by a dice roll along a leader chain.
originals.keep: 1-in-8 leader and 1-in-32 grand-leader odds; base row always present.
originals.change: A banner or horn for an elite; zone data (row 23) decides which chain can appear. Parity row 23.

originals.name: Storm Gear Ladder
originals.idea: Armour tiers with class locks: an open top tier and a paladin-only tier.
originals.keep: Top tier open to all; a paladin-only tier.
originals.change: A crest for exclusive tiers and a rim light for the middle tier; no metal shader from this donor. Parity row 15.

originals.name: Winds Trap
originals.idea: A dungeon hazard that dims the light source.
originals.change: The light flickers with a soft sound; the torch is not removed. Parity row 16.
